annotation.title_clean: National AI Strategy - AI Action Plan
annotation.title_en: National AI Strategy - AI Action Plan
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Department for Digital, Culture, Media and Sport; Department for Business, Energy and Industrial Strategy (UK Government)
annotation.summary_en: UK Government's first annual update on its 10-year National AI Strategy, reporting progress under three pillars: long-term investment, AI adoption across sectors, and effective governance. Signals a pro-innovation regulatory approach, a forthcoming AI White Paper, AI standards hub, and algorithmic transparency standard. Only passing mention of autonomous vehicles.
key_provisions_or_claims: Reports progress under three pillars: invest in AI ecosystem, diffuse AI across sectors and regions, govern AI effectively.
Announces pro-innovation approach to AI regulation with a White Paper planned for late 2022.
Pilots AI Standards Hub led by Alan Turing Institute with BSI and NPL.
Published algorithmic transparency standard and AI Assurance Roadmap.
Funding for AI skills, scholarships, compute review and a £8.5m AI ethics and regulation research programme.
